_JwtKeyNote: Jwt:Key is deliberately NOT stored here — it signs both staff tokens and the /dbadmin scope token, so a committed value grants full patient-database access to anyone with repo or artifact access. Supply it via the Jwt__Key environment variable, or an untracked appsettings.Production.json alongside the deployed binary. Development generates an ephemeral key automatically (see Configuration/JwtSettings.cs).
_DbAdminNote: DbAdmin:Username/PasswordHash are deliberately NOT stored here — this credential guards a raw-SQL console over the patient database, and a committed PBKDF2 hash can be cracked offline. Supply via DbAdmin__Username / DbAdmin__PasswordHash environment variables or an untracked appsettings.Production.json. When both are absent, VerifyCredentials fails closed and /dbadmin login is disabled entirely.
